tod_spin_vo_buy_1.text: Let's see what your luck is worth.

tod_spin_vo_buy_2.text: Feeling lucky? [giggles] They all do... at first.

tod_spin_vo_buy_3.text: [pause] Mmm. [pause] Another name for the book. [pause][giggles] Spin.

tod_spin_vo_common_1.text: Hm. [pause] The tower keeps the rest. [pause] Pity.

tod_spin_vo_epic_1.text: Ooh. [pause] Now THAT is a pretty thing. [giggles]

tod_spin_vo_epic_2.text: Well, well, well. [pause] Something down there likes you. [pause] Not me. [giggles]

tod_spin_vo_legendary_1.text: [excited] JACKPOT! [laughs maniacally] [pause][calm] ...forgive me. [pause] The mask slips, sometimes.

tod_spin_vo_legendary_2.text: [laughs maniacally] [pause][calm] Oh, that one. [pause] I took it from the last one who stood where you stand.

tod_spin_vo_close.text: Come back soon. [pause] You will. [pause] They always do.

tod_spin_vo_approach_1.text: Closer. [pause] I don't bite. [pause][giggles] The machine does.

tod_spin_vo_approach_3.text: No questions asked. [pause] No answers given. [pause] Especially about me.

tod_spin_vo_approach_4.text: You climbed all this way... [pause] and stopped at my window. [giggles] Sensible.

tod_spin_vo_no_points_2.text: Two thousand five hundred. [pause] The dead don't haggle. [pause] I have a book full of them.

tod_spin_vo_gift_offer_1.text: Empty-handed? [pause] Down here? [pause] Come closer... [giggles] the first one is on the house.
tod_spin_vo_gift_offer_1.hook: THE DEALER'S GIFT (docs/209): a player with NO companion walks up to the lit counter (replaces the greeting; no chance roll, 20 s cooldown)

tod_spin_vo_gift_offer_2.text: Nobody walks this tower alone. [pause] This city was full of little friends, once... [pause] I kept a few.
tod_spin_vo_gift_offer_2.hook: THE DEALER'S GIFT (docs/209): a player with NO companion walks up to the lit counter (replaces the greeting; no chance roll, 20 s cooldown)

tod_spin_vo_gift_spin_1.text: On the house. [pause] Keep your luck. [pause][giggles] You'll need it.
tod_spin_vo_gift_spin_1.hook: THE DEALER'S GIFT (docs/209): the gift reel slams in (keep it short: the landing line follows ~5 s later on the same lane)

tod_spin_vo_gift_spin_2.text: Every customer needs a friend. [pause] Let's see which one... chooses you.
tod_spin_vo_gift_spin_2.hook: THE DEALER'S GIFT (docs/209): the gift reel slams in (keep it short: the landing line follows ~5 s later on the same lane)

tod_spin_vo_gift_land_1.text: There. [pause] Yours now. [pause] Feed it well... [giggles] and come back when it's hungry.
tod_spin_vo_gift_land_1.hook: THE DEALER'S GIFT (docs/209): the gift reel lands on his companion (it teaches the next visit: the spins upgrade it)

tod_spin_vo_gift_land_2.text: [excited] Oh, it LIKES you! [laughs] [calm] Mm. [pause] Don't make it regret that.
tod_spin_vo_gift_land_2.hook: THE DEALER'S GIFT (docs/209): the gift reel lands on his companion (the occasional manic crack)

tod_spin_vo_busy.text: Wait your turn. [pause] The reel is listening to someone else. [pause] It listens to everyone. [giggles]

tod_spin_vo_luck_low.text: So little luck. [sighs] The machine barely notices. [pause] The walls do. [pause] They notice everything.

tod_spin_vo_luck_full.text: Oh. [pause][excited] Oh, that is a LOT of luck! [laughs] [calm] It's practically begging.

tod_spin_vo_rare_1.text: Blue. [pause] Not bad. [pause] Not enough. [pause] Never enough.

tod_spin_vo_socket_1.text: There. [pause] It's part of the beast now. [giggles] Such a good little beast.

tod_spin_vo_socket_2.text: Fits like it was always there. [pause] Funny, that. [pause] So did the mask.

tod_spin_vo_upgrade_1.text: Stronger. [pause] Hungrier. [pause] Good. [pause] The tower likes them hungry.

tod_spin_vo_upgrade_2.text: Same poison. [pause] Bigger dose. [pause][giggles] House rules.

tod_spin_vo_scrap_1.text: Throwing it back? [pause] The machine remembers generosity. [pause] I do not.

tod_spin_vo_scrap_2.text: Scrap, dust, luck. [giggles] Round and round it goes. [pause] Down and down we go.

tod_spin_vo_full_1.text: Three slots. Three chances. [pause] Choose what dies. [pause][giggles] I never could.

tod_spin_vo_item_plating.text: Plating. [pause] It'll die a little slower now. [pause] How disappointing.

tod_spin_vo_item_hollow_point.text: Hollow point. [pause] Nothing walks away from those. [pause] Well. [pause] Some things walk back.

tod_spin_vo_item_long_sight.text: Long sight. [pause] It sees them before they see you. [giggles] Lovely.

tod_spin_vo_item_nano_repair.text: Nano repair. [pause] Little machines mending a machine. [pause] This whole city was one, before it fell.

tod_spin_vo_item_arc_chain.text: Arc chain. One touch... [excited] and they ALL light up! [laughs] [calm] Like the sign. [pause] Did you see my sign?

tod_spin_vo_item_salvage.text: Salvage. [pause] It eats what it kills. [pause][giggles] Everything here does.

tod_spin_vo_item_quick_reboot.text: Quick reboot. [pause] Death is just a pause now. [pause] I would know. [pause] I'm on my third face.

tod_spin_vo_item_lucky_charm.text: Lucky charm. [pause] Careful. Luck is my business. [pause] So are debts.

tod_spin_vo_idle_1.hook: 3D at the counter, 30-60 s, player in earshot

tod_spin_vo_idle_2.text: They never ask where the prizes come from. [pause] Good. [pause] The last owners don't need them anymore.

tod_spin_vo_idle_3.text: The tower takes. [pause] I only... redistribute. [pause] The tower pays me for that.

tod_spin_vo_idle_4.text: [sighs] Mmm. [pause] Quiet tonight. [pause] Too quiet. [pause] The walls are holding their breath.

tod_spin_vo_idle_5.text: Fifty floors down and they're still coming. [pause] Good for business. [pause] Every one of them was a customer, once.

tod_spin_vo_idle_6.text: I had a face once. [pause] I paid with it. [pause] Under this mask... [pause] is a bigger mask. [giggles]

tod_spin_vo_regular_1.text: Back again. [pause] I knew you would be. [pause] Your page is getting long.
tod_spin_vo_regular_1.hook: buy line on a player's 4th+ spin

tod_spin_vo_regular_2.text: You and that machine... [giggles] it's becoming a relationship. [pause] I know the type. [pause] I was the first customer.
tod_spin_vo_regular_2.hook: buy line on a player's 4th+ spin

tod_spin_vo_sign_laugh.hook: the first jump's opening scene: THE REVEAL, as the TOWER OF DOOM II sign holds lit after the crash: an evil villain's entrance laugh, four peals non-stop (_tod_jump_title.csc, 2D on the flyer's client; not the mouth or the lane)

tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_approach_1.text: Ah. [pause] The archer. [pause] Arrows, in a city of bullets. [giggles] I admire the stubbornness.
tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_approach_1.hook: the archer's own approach line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_approach_2.text: Mind that hook of yours near my window. [pause] The last one who swung in... [pause] is still in here somewhere.
tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_approach_2.hook: the archer's own approach line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_buy_1.text: A bow against the dead. [pause] Quaint. [giggles] Let's see if your luck shoots straighter.
tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_buy_1.hook: the archer's own buy line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_buy_2.text: Spin, archer. [pause] It's quicker than your draw. [giggles] Most things are.
tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_buy_2.hook: the archer's own buy line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_close_1.text: Off you fly, little bird. [pause] Try not to land on anything that bites.
tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_close_1.hook: the archer's own close line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_socket_1.text: Fits. [pause] Now your little beast hunts as quietly as you do. [giggles] Quieter.
tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_socket_1.hook: the archer's own socket line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_approach_1.text: I smell plastic explosive. [pause] Nothing goes on my counter that ticks. [giggles] Please.
tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_approach_1.hook: the breacher's own approach line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_approach_2.text: The one who walks through his own explosions. [pause] That is how the city fell, you know. [pause] Someone walked through it.
tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_approach_2.hook: the breacher's own approach line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_buy_1.text: Shotguns and bombs. [pause] Subtle as a brick. [giggles] I have always liked bricks.
tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_buy_1.hook: the breacher's own buy line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_buy_2.text: Let's see what the machine makes of a walking crater.
tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_buy_2.hook: the breacher's own buy line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_close_1.text: Off you go. [pause] Loudly, I expect.
tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_close_1.hook: the breacher's own close line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_socket_1.text: Bolted on. [pause] Try not to blow it up with the rest of your friends.
tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_socket_1.hook: the breacher's own socket line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_approach_1.text: No gun. [pause] Just fists and a blade. [giggles] You and I would have gotten along, in another life.
tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_approach_1.hook: the warrior's own approach line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_approach_2.text: Careful with that sword near my glass. [pause] The last one who scratched it... [pause] I kept him. [giggles] Somewhere.
tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_approach_2.hook: the warrior's own approach line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_buy_1.text: A warrior, spinning a wheel. [giggles] Even steel needs a little luck.
tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_buy_1.hook: the warrior's own buy line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_buy_2.text: Put the blade down a moment. [pause] The machine prefers empty hands.
tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_buy_2.hook: the warrior's own buy line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_close_1.text: Go on. Swing. [pause] Leave some for the others. [giggles] Or don't.
tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_close_1.hook: the warrior's own close line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_socket_1.text: There. [pause] Now the beast hits as hard as you do. [pause] Almost.
tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_socket_1.hook: the warrior's own socket line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_approach_1.text: Ahh. [pause] You raise the dead too. [giggles] Competition. [pause] Mine are better behaved.
tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_approach_1.hook: the necro's own approach line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_approach_2.text: Keep your pets outside. [pause] They drool on the merchandise. [pause] And they remember me.
tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_approach_2.hook: the necro's own approach line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_buy_1.text: Souls for a spin. [pause] Now THAT is a currency I understand.
tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_buy_1.hook: the necro's own buy line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_buy_2.text: A skull that talks. [pause] Everything in this city talks, if you listen. [pause] Mostly about me.
tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_buy_2.hook: the necro's own buy line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_close_1.text: Give my regards to your dead. [giggles] Some of them were mine.
tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_close_1.hook: the necro's own close line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_socket_1.text: In it goes. [pause] Flesh, metal, a little luck. [giggles] The house recipe.
tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_socket_1.hook: the necro's own socket line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_near_1.text: Ohhh! [pause] So close. [giggles] So very close.
tod_spin_vo_near_1.hook: THE NEAR MISS (docs/201): after a STOPPED SHORT / SLIPPED PAST spin, in place of the landing line (_tod_shop spin_near_after)

tod_spin_vo_near_2.text: A whisker, my friend. [pause] A whisker.
tod_spin_vo_near_2.hook: THE NEAR MISS (docs/201): after a STOPPED SHORT / SLIPPED PAST spin, in place of the landing line (_tod_shop spin_near_after)

tod_spin_vo_near_3.text: Did you see it? [pause] It saw you, too. [giggles] Next time, hm?
tod_spin_vo_near_3.hook: THE NEAR MISS (docs/201): after a STOPPED SHORT / SLIPPED PAST spin, in place of the landing line (_tod_shop spin_near_after)

tod_spin_vo_near_4.text: Ah. [pause] The machine likes to tease. [chuckles] So do I.
tod_spin_vo_near_4.hook: THE NEAR MISS (docs/201): after a STOPPED SHORT / SLIPPED PAST spin, in place of the landing line (_tod_shop spin_near_after)

tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_near_1.text: So close, archer. [pause] Like an arrow that only grazes. [giggles]
tod_spin_vo_cls_archer_near_1.hook: the archer's own near-miss line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_near_1.text: Ha! [pause] You nearly blew the jackpot wide open.
tod_spin_vo_cls_breacher_near_1.hook: the breacher's own near-miss line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_near_1.text: One inch short, warrior. [pause] Swing again.
tod_spin_vo_cls_warrior_near_1.hook: the warrior's own near-miss line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_near_1.text: Ooh, it brushed right past you. [pause] Like a soul slipping away.
tod_spin_vo_cls_necro_near_1.hook: the necro's own near-miss line (_tod_shop vo_cls)

tod_spin_vo_hot_1.text: Hot hands tonight, friend. [pause] Let's see how long they burn.
tod_spin_vo_hot_1.hook: THE HOT STREAK (docs/201): at the pour when the player is HEATING UP or ON FIRE (_tod_shop spin)

tod_spin_vo_hot_2.text: [giggles] You're on fire. [pause] Careful... fire goes out.
tod_spin_vo_hot_2.hook: THE HOT STREAK (docs/201): at the pour when the player is HEATING UP or ON FIRE (_tod_shop spin)

tod_spin_vo_hot_3.text: Mm. [pause] The luck is running warm. [pause] Don't stop now.
tod_spin_vo_hot_3.hook: THE HOT STREAK (docs/201): at the pour when the player is HEATING UP or ON FIRE (_tod_shop spin)

tod_house_vo_welcome.text: [calm] Come in. [pause] Come in. [pause] You climbed a long way down... to stand in a room with nothing in it but me.
tod_house_vo_welcome.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the parlour cut scene, 3D from the hut's mask to every player (_tod_house.gsc): the scene opens

tod_house_vo_ledger.text: Every roll you ever made is in my ledger. [pause] Every card. Every spin. [pause] You thought the luck was yours. [giggles] It was mine. [pause] It was always mine.
tod_house_vo_ledger.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the parlour cut scene, 3D from the hut's mask to every player (_tod_house.gsc): the ledger

tod_house_vo_reveal.text: The tower didn't fall. [pause] I folded it. [pause] The sign in the sky, the domes, the voices in the walls... [pause] all of it was the house. [pause] All of it was me.
tod_house_vo_reveal.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the parlour cut scene, 3D from the hut's mask to every player (_tod_house.gsc): the mastermind

tod_house_vo_offer.text: One more roll. [pause] On the house. [pause] Go on... I insist. [giggles] Everyone gets one last roll.
tod_house_vo_offer.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the parlour cut scene, 3D from the hut's mask to every player (_tod_house.gsc): the last roll is offered (the LAST ROLL prompt comes up with it)

tod_house_vo_too_slow.text: [sighs] Too slow. [pause] I'll roll for you.
tod_house_vo_too_slow.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the parlour cut scene, 3D from the hut's mask to every player (_tod_house.gsc): nobody rolled in time, he rolls for them

tod_house_vo_cursed.text: [excited] CURSED! [laughs] Oh, look at that. [pause] The house wins. [pause] The house ALWAYS wins.
tod_house_vo_cursed.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the parlour cut scene, 3D from the hut's mask to every player (_tod_house.gsc): the reel lands on CURSED

tod_house_vo_laugh.text: [laughs maniacally] AH HA HA HA HA HA! [laughs] Oh... oh, PERFECT! [laughs hysterically] HA HA HA HA HA!
tod_house_vo_laugh.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the parlour cut scene, 3D from the hut's mask to every player (_tod_house.gsc): the laugh (user: 'he laughs like crazy'), over the cursed banner, before the teleport

tod_house_vo_send.text: [calm] Now. [pause] Let me show you where the money goes.
tod_house_vo_send.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the parlour cut scene, 3D from the hut's mask to every player (_tod_house.gsc): the teleport charges on this line

tod_house_vo_dome.text: [soft] You remember my domes. [pause] Breathe it in. [pause] I'm not taking your life. [pause] Only... everything but the last of it.
tod_house_vo_dome.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): the corrupted dome rises over the dais and the drain begins

tod_house_vo_one.text: [soft] One. [pause] One point of health. [pause] Hold on to it. [giggles] I would.
tod_house_vo_one.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): everyone is at one point of health

tod_house_vo_fight.text: [excited] The account is open. [pause] Let's SETTLE it!
tod_house_vo_fight.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): the dome breaks, the fight starts

tod_house_vo_crack.text: [pained] My FACE! [pause][laughs] Mm. [pause] You'll pay for that one.
tod_house_vo_crack.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): his mask cracks at half health (state two)

tod_house_vo_death.text: [calm] A bigger mask... [pause] under this one... [pause] always... [giggles] another.
tod_house_vo_death.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): he dies

tod_house_vo_down.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): a player goes down during the fight (sometimes)

tod_house_vo_swipe_1.text: [soft] A cut. [pause] Just a small cut... for the house.
tod_house_vo_swipe_1.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): his scythe lands on a player in state one (sometimes; the swipe deck)

tod_house_vo_swipe_2.text: [calm] A little off the top. [pause] House rules.
tod_house_vo_swipe_2.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): his scythe lands on a player in state one (sometimes; the swipe deck)

tod_house_vo_swipe_3.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): his scythe lands on a player in state one (sometimes; the swipe deck)

tod_house_vo_taunt_1.text: [excited] Faster! [laughs] The house always collects faster!
tod_house_vo_taunt_1.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): a chase taunt in state two (timed after the crack; the taunt deck)

tod_house_vo_taunt_2.text: [laughs] Run, run, run! [pause] It all goes on the account!
tod_house_vo_taunt_2.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): a chase taunt in state two (timed after the crack; the taunt deck)

tod_house_vo_taunt_3.text: [laughs maniacally] One eye is plenty! [pause] I only ever needed one for you!
tod_house_vo_taunt_3.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): a chase taunt in state two (timed after the crack; the taunt deck)

tod_house_vo_taunt_4.text: [excited] No more bets! [laughs] The table is CLOSED!
tod_house_vo_taunt_4.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): a chase taunt in state two (timed after the crack; the taunt deck)

tod_house_vo_low.text: [pained] That... [pause] was not on the price list.
tod_house_vo_low.hook: THE DEALER'S HOUSE (docs/207): the final arena, 2D on every player's client (_tod_house.gsc): he falls to a fifth of his health (once)
